target.summary: report_smb_service assumes client responds to dispatcher.tcp_socket to retrieve peerhost and peerport, but SMBv1 connections use Rex::Proto::SMB::Client which lacks a dispatcher method. When connecting to an SMBv1 target, calling report_smb_service raises a NoMethodError, crashing module execution.
notes: faulty statements calling client.dispatcher without verifying the client supports it
